content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The application dates are tentative. Candidates should confirm the final schedule after the detailed CEN No. 07/2026 is published.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The indicative notice announces 1,688 tentative vacancies across all participating Railway Recruitment Boards. Candidates should confirm the post-wise, category-wise and RRB-wise distribution from the detailed CEN before selecting their post preferences.

rows.post_category: Various Non-Technical Popular Categories - Undergraduate posts

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for undergraduate-level NTPC posts should have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognised board. Typing proficiency in English or Hindi will be required for the following posts: Junior Clerk cum Typist Accounts Clerk cum Typist

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The reference recruitment information reports an age limit of 18 to 30 years . The candidate's age will be calculated as on 1 January 2027 . Category-wise age relaxation and the exact date-of-birth limits should be confirmed from the detailed CEN No. 07/2026.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates may also receive applicable allowances and benefits according to Railway rules.

content_sections.heading: Medical Standard
content_sections.text: The medical standard will vary according to the post. Candidates should check the post-wise medical requirements in the detailed CEN before applying.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The reported selection process includes the following stages: First Stage Computer-Based Test Second Stage Computer-Based Test Typing Skill Test for applicable posts Document Verification Medical Examination The detailed examination pattern, qualifying requirements and post-wise selection stages will be governed by CEN No. 07/2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official RRB application portal at www.rrbapply.gov.in. Open the application link for RRB NTPC Undergraduate CEN No. 07/2026. Complete the registration process using accurate personal details. Verify the required primary details through Aadhaar, if available. Enter the educational, communication and category information. Select the preferred RRB and eligible posts. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting certificates. Pay the applicable application fee. Review the application carefully before final submission. Save or print the submitted application for future use.

content_sections.heading: Aadhaar Verification Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates are advised to verify their primary details through Aadhaar while filling out the application. The name and date of birth recorded in Aadhaar should match the Class 10 certificate. Aadhaar should contain the candidate's latest photograph and updated biometric details. Applications that are not Aadhaar-verified may require detailed scrutiny during different recruitment stages.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Keep Ready
content_sections.text: Aadhaar details Class 10 certificate for proof of name and date of birth Class 12 certificate and marksheet Recent photograph Signature Valid category certificate, where applicable PwBD or Ex-Servicemen certificate, where applicable Active mobile number and email address

The detailed notification and corrigenda will be published on the common RRB website. Candidates should use only official RRB websites and avoid touts, brokers and job racketeers.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The indicative notice announces 1,688 tentative vacancies across all participating RRBs.

faq.question: Q2. What is the notification number?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted under Centralised Employment Notification No. 07/2026.

faq.question: Q3. When will the online application process begin?
faq.answer: The online application process is tentatively scheduled to begin on 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The tentative last date is 13 November 2026 up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates should have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognised board.

faq.question: Q6. Which posts are expected under RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts include Commercial cum Ticket Clerk, Junior Clerk cum Typist, Accounts Clerk cum Typist and Trains Clerk.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The reported age limit is 18 to 30 years, calculated as on 1 January 2027. Candidates should confirm it from the detailed CEN.
